G2.note: ORF5, 436-455 aa, named G2 by its describing paper: a putative accessory glycoprotein with a transmembrane segment at residues 429-448 and several glycosylation sites (PMID 25918239). No function has been shown, so the uncharacterized string is used and the published symbol is kept.

M.note: ORF3, 231 aa, multiple transmembrane segments, with no detectable similarity to other nidovirus M proteins (PMID 25918239).

ORF1A.note: pp1a, 3,111-3,114 aa; carries a Ser/Thr protein kinase domain, three transmembrane regions and a main-protease domain between TM2 and TM3, all assigned by sequence analysis (PMID 25918239). No protease from this genus has been expressed or assayed, so no mature peptide is declared.

ORF1AB.build_note: min_len/max_len in amino acids, from the 15 transcript_edit references this build wrote: observed 5109-5110 aa, with 10% slack either side.
ORF1AB.note: Expressed by -1 ribosomal frameshifting at UUUAAAC (PMID 25918239; KM589359 CDS join(487..9825,9825..15818)). ORF1b carries the RdRp, helicase and exoribonuclease; this is the only nidovirus known to lack both NendoU and the O-methyltransferase. No PSSM.

ORF6.note: The unnamed 267 nt / 88 aa ORF near the 3' end of the genome, with no similarity to any known protein (PMID 25918239). ORF6 is this module's own key for it; the paper gives it no name.

S.note: ORF2, 562 aa -- the shortest nidovirus spike reported, with a predicted signal peptide and a C-terminal transmembrane anchor, and 17% identity to the python serpentovirus spike (PMID 25918239). The signal-peptide cleavage site is predicted only, so no mature product is declared.
